title: Skydance Gains Full TV Control of NCAA Men’s March Madness Rights Starting in 2027

facts.fact: Skydance holds exclusive television, digital, and related rights to the NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament (March Madness) effective for the 2027 edition, continuing through the existing contract term ending in 2032.
facts.quote: effective for the 2027 edition and continuing through the existing contract term ending in 2032

facts.fact: The combined annual rights fee for the NCAA men's tournament is approximately $1.1 billion, under an extended agreement that runs through 2032.
facts.quote: The combined annual rights fee for the tournament stands at approximately $1.1 billion

facts.fact: The joint CBS and Turner model originated from a 2010 agreement valued at $10.8 billion over 14 years.
facts.quote: a 2010 agreement valued at $10.8 billion over 14 years

facts.fact: The joint CBS and Turner agreement was later extended by eight years for an additional $8.8 billion.
facts.quote: later extended by eight years for an additional $8.8 billion

facts.fact: CBS held sole rights to the entire NCAA men's tournament package from 1991 through 2010.
CBS first secured the NCAA tournament rights in 1982 after outbidding NBC.
facts.quote: CBS first secured the rights in 1982 after outbidding NBC

facts.fact: From 1982 to 1990, CBS shared some early-round tournament coverage with ESPN.
facts.quote: From 1982 to 1990, CBS shared some early-round coverage with ESPN

facts.fact: The NCAA exercised an opt-out clause after the 2010 championship, leading to the multi-network deal with CBS and Turner that launched the following year.
facts.quote: the NCAA exercised an opt-out clause after the 2010 championship

facts.fact: Under the prior joint structure, tournament games were split across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
facts.quote: games were split across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV

facts.fact: The Final Four and national championship alternated between CBS and TBS in even- and odd-numbered years under the joint model.
facts.quote: the Final Four and national championship alternated between CBS and TBS in even- and odd-numbered years

facts.fact: The 2026 tournament is scheduled with shared CBS and TNT Sports coverage and proceeds under the prior arrangement.
facts.quote: The 2026 tournament, already scheduled with shared CBS and TNT Sports coverage, proceeds under the prior arrangement

facts.fact: The NCAA has expanded the tournament field for the 2027 editions of both the men's and women's championships.
facts.quote: The NCAA has already expanded the tournament field for the 2027 editions of both the men’s and women’s championships

facts.fact: The Paramount acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery closed on October 6, after settlements resolved antitrust challenges from a group of states and the Writers Guild of America.
facts.quote: The merger itself closed on October 6 after settlements resolved antitrust challenges from a group of states and the Writers Guild of America

facts.fact: Regulatory approvals for the Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery combination had been secured in dozens of jurisdictions.
facts.quote: Regulatory approvals had been secured in dozens of jurisdictions
